targets.rawSql: SELECT measured_at AS time, temperature_c AS value, device_id || ' / measured' AS metric FROM simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL ORDER BY measured_at

SELECT measured_at AS time, setpoint_c AS value, device_id || ' / setpoint' AS metric FROM simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND setpoint_c IS NOT NULL ORDER BY measured_at
SELECT measured_at AS time, heater_voltage AS value, device_id AS metric FROM simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) ORDER BY measured_at
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(measured_at)))::double precision AS age_seconds FROM simulation_measurements WHERE device_id IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Gjennomsnittlig absolutt avvik
panels.description: Prøvegjennomsnitt av |settpunkt - rå temperatur| i valgt periode. Gamle målinger uten settpunkt utelates. Ikke regulatorens filtrerte avvik.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(abs(setpoint_c - temperature_c)) AS "Absolutt avvik" FROM public.simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND setpoint_c IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Min. / maks. temperatur
panels.description: Laveste og høyeste rå temperatur i valgt periode og valgte enheter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(temperature_c) AS "Minimum", max(temperature_c) AS "Maksimum" FROM public.simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Gjennomsnittlig pådrag
panels.description: Prøvegjennomsnitt i valgt periode. Pådrag i volt, ikke elektrisk effekt eller energi.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(heater_voltage) AS "Pådrag" FROM public.simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Endre settpunkt på Pi
panels.description: Gjelder airheater-sim-1. Kontrollnøkkel fylles inn per kommando og lagres ikke i JSON. Bekreftelsen kommer fra Pi. Grafen oppdateres ved neste telemetrimelding.
